_doc: Spoken forms for the TTS engine. 'exact' = whole-token replacements (case-sensitive). 'ext' = spoken form of file extensions after a dot. 'as_word' = ALLCAPS tokens read as words, not spelled out. Everything else ALLCAPS (2-6 letters) is spelled letter by letter.

exact.~/.claude/projects/: the dot claude slash projects folder
exact.claude.ai/code: claude dot A I slash code
